quests.title: Temple Inquiry

dialogue.t: Here comes one of those spirits...
My name is...
Aberaku, Helios-Forger!
How could I have been felled by your vile slander, or imprisoned by your puppet infants!?
I— No, wait. I was imprisoned for months and years beyond count, was I not? Then... This must be my post-life form?
"Post-life form"? You mean that you're already dead, right?
Takes a pretty rare spirit to realize that.
And yet, though it shames me to say so, I know not just how I died...
But I recall that I was imprisoned on orders from a child.
A child?
Indeed. But till today, I can never feel any hatred for that child, only pity.
He was not at fault. The blame should fall upon those who controlled him like a puppet in their palms... Forget it. Such things are best left unsaid.
After that, I was imprisoned...
Imprisoned in a...
In a...?
In a very high place.
But though it was high up, it was dark, lightless, and cold as the ice itself.
...Strange. Why is that?
Why do I feel that a high place should have brought a person warmth and comfort?
Why... Why can't I remember any of this?
Are you hungry, maybe?
Whenever Paimon's famished, forget thinking, she can barely even talk straight!

dialogue.sit: I don't think that's his issue...
Well, it just so happens that we have some emergen—

dialogue.t: Come on, it's gotta be! Look at him, he can hardly speak clearly!
Actually, {NICKNAME}, could you check if there's something to eat amongst the offerings?
Wait! That's it! The offerings!
What, do you wanna eat them?
No, I just remembered...
When I died in prison, my attire and body were enshrined in various places due to my contribution in creating the Helios.
But that also caused my spirit to be separated and rendered unable to rest.
This place should have been the resting place of my sacred crown, though it has surely decayed by now. This must surely be why my thoughts are so... stuck.
If this persists, I doubt that even my current state can be sustained for long...
But these offerings can be used to replace the remnants of my body and my attire in sustaining an ounce of my thoughts.
As such, please take them with you.
However, there are many perils on the enshrining path. So though it may seem rude of me, could you accept a certain test first?
Test? What test?
Please defeat the monsters hereabouts, the prison wardens of my spirit.
This matter is perilous. Tell me once you are ready, O Traveler, and we shall begin.
Are you fully girded up, Traveler?
Then I wish you... every success in your battle ahead.

dialogue.sit: I need a while more to prepare.

dialogue.t: Then I shall await your tidings.
Ah, if only Byakuyakoku had such valiant warriors as you! Then...
*sigh* If this thing is done, then my wishes shall be fulfilled.
You must bring these offerings bearing my thoughts to be enshrined... in the place where I was held under arrest. We must do this, in order to...
In order to what?
In order to... In order to...
Ugh, there's no use talking to this guy now. Seems like his spirit's all messed up again.
{NICKNAME}, let's just take those items with us.
But where was this high-up place where this guy was imprisoned?

quests.description: Clear the trials according to the path prescribed by the spirit named Aberaku and obtain the offerings…
